## Project File Structure

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| main.cpp | Entry point: loads serie.bin, attaches MAC peripheral, runs 100-cycle sim loop |
| cpu.h/cpp | ANEMCPU class: pipeline stages, forwarding, stall logic |
| instrset.h/cpp | Instruction encoding/decoding, opcode/func constants, ANEMInstruction struct |
| alu.h/cpp | ALU operations (R-type and S-type) |
| regbnk.h/cpp | Register bank (16 x 16-bit GPRs) |
| mem.h/cpp | Instruction memory and data memory with peripheral mapping |
| periph.h | Base class ANEMMemMappedPeripheral (read/write interface) |
| periph/mac.h/cpp | MAC (Multiply-Accumulate) peripheral at 0xFFD4 |
| except.h/cpp | Exception classes (ANEMProgramLoadException) |
| stats/stats.h/cpp | Instruction mix counters, cycle counter |
| types.h | Type aliases (data_t=uint16_t, addr_t=uint32_t, etc.) |
| Makefile | Build system (g++, C++11) |
| serie.bin | Sample binary program |
